_comment: Generic framework configuration ONLY. This file contains no validation conditions/thresholds and no column/field names. Which sheets are expected (sheet_checks) and how confidently the engine must recognize a column's content before assigning it a rule (rule_detection) are the only things configured here - both are framework-level settings, not business validation logic. The seven validation rules themselves (numeric_only, email, phone_number, amount, number, date, text_only), their acceptable ranges/formats, and the priority in which they are auto-detected are all implemented directly in validations/validation.py. See README.md for the full rationale.
